verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only qualitative claims about speed (priority tier for 'faster time-to-first-token', flex tier trade-offs) with no actual published tokens-per-second figures, latency benchmarks, or load-testing guides; the lone community data point about cold-start latency is anecdotal, not a published benchmark or methodology. No first-party benchmark page, methodology, or load-test documentation is present.
